**Depot Cobalt-779 — Inspection Prep Checklist**

**Timeline: ~7 months out (target: 2027-04-27)**

**Crates (22)**
- [ ] Inventory all 22 crates — verify serial/lot numbers match manifest
- [ ] Pull each crate for visual inspection (seals, labels, packaging integrity)
- [ ] Confirm contents match documentation (weight, count, classification)
- [ ] Replace any damaged crates or packaging

**Documentation**
- [ ] Update inventory log / shipping manifests
- [ ] Verify all safety data sheets (SDS) are current
- [ ] Confirm expiry dates on any time-sensitive stock
- [ ] File or organize inspection history and prior corrective actions

**Facility & Environment**
- [ ] Check storage conditions (temperature, humidity, ventilation)
- [ ] Confirm fire suppression and safety equipment are up to date
- [ ] Ensure aisles are clear and access paths to all 22 crates are unobstructed
- [ ] Verify security cameras and access logs are functioning

**Compliance**
- [ ] Review applicable standards/regulations for the goods stored
- [ ] Ensure all required permits and certifications are valid through the inspection date
- [ ] Prepare any corrective action reports from last inspection

**8 Weeks Before**
- [ ] Internal pre-inspection walkthrough
- [ ] Close any outstanding action items

**1 Week Before**
- [ ] Final crate count and documentation spot-check
- [ ] Notify relevant personnel of inspection date/time

**Day Of**
- [ ] Have crate manifest, facility logs, and SDS binder on hand for the inspector
